field_evidence_note: Each index names the dossier evidence item that actually supports the canonical field; the promotion step emits one formal evidence row per field/index pair.
limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No Oracle server was started and no crafted tolerance was executed; the finding is static. The upstream regression tests were read, not run.
The issue is Oracle-only: both vulnerable paths are as_oracle methods, and the added tests are skipped unless connection.vendor == 'oracle'.

Reachability requires an application to pass an untrusted value as the tolerance argument of a GIS function or aggregate. Django's public GIS API accepts tolerance, but not every application exposes it to user input.
The CVE v5 CNA record is a placeholder (vendor/product/version n/a) with no CVSS and no CWE. NVD and GHSA/OSV supply CWE-89 and CVSS 3.1 8.8; the canonical values come from those sources.

The upstream announcement is dated 2020-03-04, the CVE record is dated 2020-03-05T14:49:57Z and NVD is dated 2020-03-05T15:15:12Z. GitHub's advisory record was published later, on 2020-06-05. The canonical published_at uses the CVE record.

The fix exists as four branch-specific commits. OSV and NVD cite only the master commit 6695d29b, which never shipped in a fixed release tag; the announcement lists the 3.0.x, 2.2.x and 1.11.x backports. Only 26a5cf83 is an ancestor of 3.0.4, and it is absent from 3.0.2 and 3.0.3. This dossier verifies the 3.0.x backport against the 3.0.2 snapshot.

The 1.11.29 branch fix is not identical to the 2.2/3.0 fix: it still formats a numeric tolerance into the template, but first passes it through _handle_param(..., NUMERIC_TYPES), so a string tolerance raises TypeError. The 2.2.11 and 3.0.4 branches use Value and bound parameters. Both shapes are recorded; the canonical location describes the 3.0.2 code and its 3.0.4 fix.
The regression tests assert rejection of hostile strings and correct numeric behavior, but they only run on Oracle and were not executed.
The snapshot inventory has 6163 tracked files and 67 ambiguous files; the language job is NEEDS_REVIEW, not a clean PASS.
No downstream distribution backport (Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, NetApp) was verified; only upstream tags and commits are used.

critical_operation.description: OracleToleranceMixin.as_oracle builds the Oracle SQL template with Python string formatting. The tolerance value is read from the caller-supplied extra kwargs and interpolated into a %s slot with the % operator before Func.as_sql runs. Func.as_sql then applies `template % data` with params collected only from the source expressions, so the tolerance becomes SQL text rather than a bound parameter. A string containing SQL syntax therefore breaks out of the function argument. GeoAggregate.as_oracle repeats the same mistake in aggregates.py by placing %(tolerance)s inside the SDOAGGRTYPE template. The 3.0.4 fix wraps the numeric tolerance in Value and appends it as a source expression, giving it a bound parameter.

entry_point.description: An application calls a GIS function such as Distance with a tolerance argument, and the queryset compiles to Oracle SQL. The tolerance is the injection point when it is derived from request data; the value reaches OracleToleranceMixin.as_oracle and is formatted into the SQL template.
